3M Company.note: 3M Company operates independently, though its healthcare business including the Tegaderm brand spun off as Solventum in 2024.

Argotec, LLC.note: Argotec LLC was acquired by SWM in 2015 and integrated into its advanced materials platform, later becoming Mativ Holdings.

Chen Yo Plastic Co., Ltd..note: Chen Yo Plastic Co., Ltd. operates independently as a manufacturer of PE films and packaging.

Dr. Ausbüttel & Co. GmbH.note: Dr. Ausbüttel & Co. GmbH operates independently under its own name in the medical and wound care sector.

Fengchen Group Co., Ltd..note: Fengchen Group Co., Ltd. operates independently as a medical and pharmaceutical products supplier.

Haining Fangsheng Packaging Materials Co.note: Haining Fangsheng Packaging Materials Co., Ltd. operates independently as a packaging materials manufacturer.

Klöckner Pentaplast Group.note: Klöckner Pentaplast Group completed a financial restructuring in 2026, transferring ownership to funds led by Redwood Capital Management.

Mitsui Chemicals Tohcello, Inc..note: The packaging solution business of Mitsui Chemicals Tohcello merged with Sun-Tox to form RM Tohcello Co., Ltd. under Rengo ownership in 2024.

Nova Flexipack Pvt. Ltd..note: Nova Flexipack Pvt. Ltd. operates independently as a private flexible packaging manufacturer in India.

Pearl Poly Pack.note: Pearl Poly Pack operates independently as a manufacturer of plastic packaging solutions.

Polyplex Corporation Ltd..note: Polyplex Corporation Ltd. is an independent global manufacturer of plastic films and has not been acquired.

SO.L.TER. S.r.l..note: SO.L.TER. S.r.l. operates as an independent manufacturer of polyurethane bonded fabrics and extruded films.

Sterileright Packaging Mfg Inc..note: Sterileright Packaging Mfg Inc. operates independently as a manufacturer of disposable sterilization packaging materials.

Trioworld AB.note: Trioworld AB is an independent producer of high-performance polyethylene and polypropylene films owned by Altor Equity Partners.

ZACROS Corporation.note: ZACROS Corporation, formerly known as Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd., changed its group name to ZACROS in April 2024 and remains independent.

Al-Abd Group.note: Al-Abd Group, established in 2019 in Egypt, operates as an independent manufacturer and supplier of medical supplies and barrier films.

Plavinil Argentina S.A.I.C..note: Plavinil Argentina S.A.I.C., established in 1947, operates independently while maintaining a strategic alignment/alliance to produce pharmaceutical packaging films alongside Tekni-Plex Argentina.

Solventum Corporation.note: Solventum Corporation was launched as an independent publicly traded company following its spin-off from 3M Company in 2024.
